args.question: Champ select coaching Fizz vs Malzahar with enemy Wukong, Darius, Jinx, guessed Yasuo support.
claims: Against Malzahar, consume his passive shield before using Fizz's ultimate.
The matchup build starts Doran's Ring and two Health Potions, then Lich Bane, Zhonya's Hourglass, and Shadowflame, with Sorcerer's Shoes.
The matchup rune page is Electrocute, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos, Treasure Hunter; Transcendence, Scorch; Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, Health Scaling; Flash and Ignite.

turns.text:
Lane: Malzahar passive up: Q through his shield first, dodge his E spread.
Kill: Passive broken and Malzahar low: ult-all-in; otherwise farm and keep pressure mid.
Threat: Wukong flank or Malzahar suppression: hold E to dodge engage, then escape.
Fights: Wukong commits and Malzahar’s shield is gone: ult Jinx first.
Runes: Electrocute, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos, Treasure Hunter; Transcendence, Scorch; Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, Health Scaling; Flash, Ignite
Build: Doran's Ring + 2 Health Potions → Lich Bane → Sorcerer's Shoes → Zhonya's Hourglass → Shadowflame
Swap: Build Zhonya's Hourglass before Shadowflame into Wukong's dive.

data.tip: Try to consume Malzahar’s (P) as soon as you can. Keep in mind that Malzahar’s (P) can shield him from your ultimate [R]!

judgment.note: Jev screen: relevance and prompt-injection routing, not a truth check; kept passages stay untrusted.
